decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Subject to planning conditions requiring pedestrian visibility splays and maintenance of boundary treatment except at point of access, it is considered that the proposed vehicular crossover would be safe to use, not impair the safety of other road and footway users, and not detract from the street scene.

Condition : 2 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.
Condition : 3 - The point of vehicular access hereby permitted shall be no wider than 2.4 metres.
Condition : 4 - The means of enclosure at the front boundary shall be retained except at the point of access, unless otherwise agreed in writing ny the Local Planning Authority.
description: Construction of vehicle crossover to front of dwellinghouse.
